report_name: North Korea's Lazarus Group Operations Decomposed into Six Clusters

threat_actors.name: Lazarus Group
threat_actors.description: A North Korean state-sponsored threat group, described as a collection of at least six distinct operational clusters directed by the General Reconnaissance Bureau (GRIB). These clusters specialize in missions including cyberespionage, financial theft, and sanctions evasion.

threat_actors.name: TEMP.Hermit
threat_actors.description: One of the six distinct operational clusters identified as part of the broader Lazarus Group operations.

threat_actors.name: Citrine Sleet
threat_actors.description: One of the six distinct operational clusters identified as part of the broader Lazarus Group operations.

threat_actors.name: CryptoCore
threat_actors.description: A financially-motivated operational cluster of the Lazarus Group, formerly part of APT38, that focuses on targeting cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, and Web3 entities to steal digital assets.

threat_actors.name: Jade Sleet
threat_actors.description: A financially-motivated operational cluster of the Lazarus Group, formerly part of APT38, that focuses on targeting cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, and Web3 entities to steal digital assets.

threat_actors.name: Moonstone Sleet
threat_actors.description: A hybrid operational cluster of the Lazarus Group that conducts both cyberespionage and financially motivated attacks. It has been observed using the Qilin ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) platform.

threat_actors.name: Famous Chollima
threat_actors.description: An operational cluster of the Lazarus Group linked to the North Korean IT worker program. This cluster uses remote workers with false identities as insider threats to gain initial access, and was implicated in the $62.5 million Munchables protocol exploit.

threat_actors.name: APT38
threat_actors.description: A financially-motivated North Korean threat group whose activities are now believed to be split between the CryptoCore and Jade Sleet clusters within the Lazarus Group structure.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Used by Lazarus Group clusters for initial access, often targeting employees in the cryptocurrency and finance sectors.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: The primary objective of the CryptoCore and Jade Sleet clusters, which target cryptocurrency exchanges and DeFi protocols to steal digital assets.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
attack_patterns.description: Used by the Famous Chollima cluster as part of its IT worker infiltration scheme to establish credible false identities for remote work opportunities, which are then used to gain insider access.

attack_patterns.name: Visual Basic
attack_patterns.description: Used in malicious documents for initial compromise by Lazarus Group clusters.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used by Lazarus Group clusters to gain access to vulnerable servers, particularly those in the DeFi space.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: A ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) platform used by the Moonstone Sleet cluster for financially motivated attacks, indicating a convergence of state-sponsored and cybercriminal ecosystems.

identities.name: General Reconnaissance Bureau (GRIB)
identities.description: North Korea's intelligence bureau that directs most of the Lazarus Group's operational clusters.

identities.name: Munchables
identities.description: A DeFi protocol that was exploited for $62.5 million, an attack attributed to the Famous Chollima cluster's IT worker infiltration program.

identities.name: Cryptocurrency and Web3 entities
identities.description: A class of organizations, including cryptocurrency exchanges and DeFi protocols, that are primary targets for financially-motivated Lazarus clusters like CryptoCore and Jade Sleet.

infrastructure.name: DPRK Cyber Operations Support Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A global network of front companies and infrastructure used by Lazarus Group clusters to launder stolen funds and obscure their operational footprint.

indicators.name: Suspicious Payload Download via cURL and Bash
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Payload Download and Execution via cURL Pipe to Shell
id: 2f8b1c3a-9e4d-4f8a-b1c3-d4e5f6a7b8c9
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'curl' to download a script from a remote location and pipe it directly to a shell for execution. This is a common TTP for initial access and payload delivery.
references:
  - https://kudelskisecurity.com/research/beyond-lazarus-organization-of-dprk-cyber-capabilities
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-07
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1105
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'curl http' # Could be https
      - '| bash'
      - '| sh'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a command line pattern where a script is downloaded via cURL and executed by a shell, a technique associated with Lazarus Group operations.

indicators.name: Suspicious Job Application Email
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Job Application Email for Initial Access
id: 5a4b3c2d-1e9f-4a8b-9c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects emails with subjects or attachment names containing 'job application', which may be used in phishing campaigns by groups like Lazarus to infiltrate organizations via their IT worker program.
references:
  - https://kudelskisecurity.com/research/beyond-lazarus-organization-of-dprk-cyber-capabilities
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-07
tags:
  - attack.t1566
  - attack.t1589
level: medium
logsource:
  category: email
detection:
  selection_subject:
    Subject|contains: 'job application'
  selection_attachment:
    Attachment|contains: 'job application'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects emails containing the string 'job application', a potential indicator of phishing attempts related to the North Korean IT worker infiltration scheme.
